```{r dependencies}
# gt star formatter https://github.com/rstudio/gt/issues/187

# Create a simple formatter for statistical significance
# (creating stars from p values)
fmt_stars <- function(data, columns, rows = NULL) {
  
  # Capture expression in `rows`
  rows <- rlang::enquo(rows)
  
  # Pass `data`, `columns`, `rows`, and the formatting
  # functions as a function list to `fmt()`
  fmt(
    data = data,
    columns = columns,
    rows = !!rows,
    fns = list(
      default = function(x) {
        dplyr::case_when(
          x < 0.005 ~ "***",
          x < 0.01  ~ "**",
          x < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE      ~ ""
        )
      }
    )
  )
}
```

## Prepare data for survival analysis

```{r}
survival_dat1 <- survival_dat %>% 
  drop_na(pat_id, status) %>% 
  left_join(clean_all_meta, by=c("pat_id"="patID"))

no.ukhd.pats <- length(grep(pattern = "UKL-HD", x = data$patID, ignore.case = TRUE))
fu.rate <- round(100/no.ukhd.pats * nrow(survival_dat1), 2)

(disease.no <- table(survival_dat1$disease))
```

Out of `r no.ukhd.pats` patients that were enrolled at the University Hospital Heidelberg we gathered Follow-Up data (ac-mortality) in `r nrow(survival_dat1)` (missing Follow-Up Rate = `r fu.rate`%). Among these patients `r disease.no["acs"]` patients suffered from ACS, `r disease.no["cad"]` patients had CAD, `r disease.no["dcm"]` patients had DCM, and `r disease.no["control"]` participants were assigned to the control group. 

We filter patients with HFpEF (n=5) and HFrEF (n=3).

```{r filter-patients}
survival_dat1 <- survival_dat1 %>% 
  filter(disease != "pef" & disease != "ref") %>% 
  mutate(time = time/365)

table(survival_dat1$disease)
```

# ML models survival probs

## Load ML models and predict probs


We now predict all models we have per disease and add the probabilities to our survival data. 

```{r predict-whole-disease-dataset-and-filter-ukhd}
# only have surv data from 3 diseases
model.disease.vector <- c("acs", "cad", "dcm")

# load 1 race result to extract the wflow ids
race_results <- readRDS(glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/tuning_results/acs/003c_20240121_tune_race_results_repeats_10_folds_5_ACS_analysis_SELECTED_miRetrieve_TRUE_randomMIR_FALSE_more_logit_matchIt.rds"))

wflow_id_vector <- race_results$wflow_id

for (model.disease in 1:length(model.disease.vector)) {
  # load disease specific data from 001c ----------------------------------------------------------
  # specific to this script (preprocessing, filtered miRNAs with Detection Matrix, batch effects removed)
  path2dataprocessed <- glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/data/Rdata/processed_disease_data/001c_{model.disease.vector[model.disease]}_data01.rds")
  if(!file.exists(path2dataprocessed)) {
    next
  }
  
  data01 <- readRDS(file = path2dataprocessed)
  
  # select disease specific models
  # index <- grep(pattern = model.disease.vector[model.disease], x = name2assignModelInEnv)
  
  for(mymodel in 1:length(wflow_id_vector)) {
    # load test results stored in 004c
    test_results_tmp <- readRDS(glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/test_set_results/test_results_202311/{model.disease.vector[model.disease]}/selected_analysis/004c_20240121_TEST_RESULTS_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_analysis_selected_MATCHED.rds"))

    extract.workflow.loop <- extract_workflow(test_results_tmp)
    
    predictions <- predict(extract.workflow.loop, new_data=data01, type = "prob")
    # 
    colname_pred_control <- glue("{colnames(predictions)[1]}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_{model.disease.vector[model.disease]}")
    colname_pred_disease <- glue("{colnames(predictions)[2]}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_{model.disease.vector[model.disease]}")
    
    data01[1] %>% 
      cbind(predictions) -> temp.dat
    
    survival_dat1 <- survival_dat1 %>% 
      left_join(temp.dat, by = join_by(pat_id)) %>% 
      rename(!! colname_pred_control := !! colnames(predictions)[1],
             !! colname_pred_disease := !! colnames(predictions)[2]) 
    
    #mtcars %>% 
    #rename("PREFIX_{ OLD_COL_NAME }" := !! OLD_COL_NAME)
  }
}
```


## Use predictions and plot KM


```{r}

#cave : somewhere in deployment the .pred_control and corresponding disease column was called .pred_acs instead of .pred_{disease}
## fixed that bug on 2023-03-08 (bug in this script because of some test vector)

lab2023 <- read_excel(path = glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/data/elham2023/2023-11-15-elham_metadat_combined_LAB2023_b.xlsx")) %>% 
  filter(best_ageing_code %in% survival_dat1$pat_id) %>% 
  select(best_ageing_code, HSTNT, HSTNTHP, NTBNP, INR, BILI, KREA, LEUKO, CRP, HB, CHOL) %>% 
  mutate(
    HSTNT = case_when(is.na(HSTNT) ~ HSTNTHP,
                      .default = HSTNT)
  ) %>% 
  # drop duplicates
  distinct(best_ageing_code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  # convert to numeric and change "," -> "." for decimals
  mutate(across(!c(best_ageing_code), function(x) as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", x)) )) %>% 
  select(-HSTNTHP) # is second TNT, first TNT measured in HSTNT, kinetics


survival_dat1 <- survival_dat1 %>% 
  left_join(lab2023, by=c("pat_id"="best_ageing_code")) %>% 
  mutate(
    bnp = case_when(
      is.na(bnp) ~ NTBNP,
      .default = bnp
    ),
    troponinT = case_when(
      is.na(troponinT) ~ HSTNT,
      .default = troponinT
    ),
    crea = case_when(
      is.na(crea) ~ KREA,
      .default = crea
    ),
    hemo = case_when(
      is.na(hemo) ~ HB,
      .default = hemo
    ),
    wbc = case_when(
      is.na(wbc) ~ LEUKO,
      .default = wbc
    ),
    cholesterol = case_when(
      is.na(cholesterol) ~ CHOL,
      .default = cholesterol
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(CHOL, LEUKO, HB, KREA, HSTNT, NTBNP))


for (mydisease in 1:length(model.disease.vector)) {

  ## df ONLY looking at patients with disease (no control) 
  survival_dat1.disease <- survival_dat1 %>% 
    filter(disease == !! model.disease.vector[mydisease]) 
  
  # stars to format gt table later
  logrank_pval_df_tmp <- tibble(model = character(), pval2group.logrank = numeric(), stars2 = numeric(), pval3group.logrank = numeric(), stars3 = numeric())
  
  # now loop over all models
  for(mymodel in 1:length(wflow_id_vector)) {
    
    colname_pred_control <- glue(".pred_control_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_{model.disease.vector[mydisease]}")
    colname_pred_disease <- glue(".pred_{model.disease.vector[mydisease]}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_{model.disease.vector[mydisease]}")
    
    ## df filter patients that have predictions because they have miRNA data
    survival_dat1.disease <- survival_dat1.disease %>% 
      filter(!is.na(!! sym(colname_pred_control))) 
    
    # create tertiles
    survival_dat1.disease <- survival_dat1.disease %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups = cut_number(.data[[colname_pred_disease]], n=3)) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups = factor(model.pred.groups, labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high"))) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups2 = cut_number(.data[[colname_pred_disease]], n=2)) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups2 = factor(model.pred.groups2, labels = c("low", "high")))
    
    
    # easy KM TERTILES
    sfit_diseases <- survfit(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ model.pred.groups, data = survival_dat1.disease)
    logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ model.pred.groups, data = survival_dat1.disease)
    surv.plotname <- glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/plots/survival/005c_selected_matched/005c_20240121_KM_{toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease])}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_selected_matchIt.svg")
    ggsurvplot_custom_poster(fit_object = sfit_diseases, mytitle=NULL, legend.title = "", 
                      myXbreaks = c(1, 2,3,4, 5),
                      legend.labs = c("low", "intermediate", "high"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                      save = TRUE, plotname = surv.plotname)
    
    #     
    surv.plotname_nolabels <- glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/plots/survival/005c_selected_matched/005c_20240121_KM_{toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease])}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_selected_matchIt_nolabels.svg")
    ggsurvplot_custom_poster_nolabels(fit_object = sfit_diseases, mytitle=NULL, legend.title = "", 
                      myXbreaks = c(1, 2,3,4, 5),
                      legend.labs = c("low", "intermediate", "high"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                      save = TRUE, plotname = surv.plotname_nolabels)
    
    
    
    # easy KM low-high 
    sfit_diseases_BIN <- survfit(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ model.pred.groups2, data = survival_dat1.disease)
    logrank_test_BIN <- survdiff(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ model.pred.groups2, data = survival_dat1.disease)
    
    surv.plotname_BIN <- glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/plots/survival/005c_selected_BINARY_matched/005c_20240121_KM_{toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease])}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_selected_BINARY_matchIt.svg")
    ggsurvplot_custom_poster(fit_object = sfit_diseases_BIN, mytitle=NULL, legend.title = "", 
                             line_colour = c("#009E73", "#E69F00"), myXbreaks = c(1, 2,3,4, 5),
                             legend.labs = c("low", "high"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                             save = TRUE, plotname = surv.plotname_BIN)
    
    surv.plotname_BIN_nolabels <- glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/plots/survival/005c_selected_BINARY_matched/005c_20240121_KM_{toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease])}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_selected_BINARY_matchIt_nolabels.svg")
    ggsurvplot_custom_poster_nolabels(fit_object = sfit_diseases_BIN, mytitle=NULL, 
                                      line_colour = c("#009E73", "#E69F00"), myXbreaks = c(1, 2,3,4, 5),
                                      legend.labs = c("none"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                                      save = TRUE, plotname = surv.plotname_BIN_nolabels)
    
    # fill up p-vals
    logrank_pval_df_tmp <- add_row(logrank_pval_df_tmp, 
                               model = wflow_id_vector[mymodel], 
                               pval2group.logrank = logrank_test_BIN$pvalue, 
                               stars2 = logrank_test_BIN$pvalue, 
                               pval3group.logrank = logrank_test$pvalue,
                               stars3 = logrank_test$pvalue)
    
    # create descriptive stats -------------------------------------------
    table_survival_tmp <- survival_dat1.disease %>% 
      select(pat_id, disease, status5y, #time, 
             age, sex, weight, bmi, smoke, dm, hypertension, familiyhist, 
             # lab
             crea, troponinT, bnp, hemo, INR, BILI, wbc, CRP, cholesterol, 
             #
             echo_ef, echo_lv_dil,
             model.pred.groups, .data[[colname_pred_disease]]
      ) %>% 
      mutate(status5y = factor(status5y, labels = c("Survived", "Died"))) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups = factor(model.pred.groups, labels = c("Low", "Intermediate", "High"))) %>% 
      mutate(
        dm = case_when(
          dm == "No" ~ "No", 
          .default = "Yes"
        ),
        smoke = case_when(
          smoke == "Never" ~"No",
          .default = "Yes"
        ),
        hypertension = case_when(
          hypertension == "Yes" ~"Yes",
          .default = "No"
        ),
        familiyhist = case_when(
          familiyhist == "Yes" ~"Yes",
          .default = "No"
        ),
      )
    
    # binary
    table_survival_BIN_tmp <- survival_dat1.disease %>% 
      select(pat_id, disease, status5y, #time, 
             age, sex, weight, bmi, smoke, dm, hypertension, familiyhist, 
             # lab
             crea, troponinT, bnp, hemo, INR, BILI, wbc, CRP, cholesterol, 
             #
             echo_ef, echo_lv_dil,
             model.pred.groups2, .data[[colname_pred_disease]]
      ) %>% 
      mutate(status5y = factor(status5y, labels = c("Survived", "Died"))) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups2 = factor(model.pred.groups2, labels = c("Low", "High"))) %>% 
      mutate(
        dm = case_when(
          dm == "No" ~ "No", 
          .default = "Yes"
        ),
        smoke = case_when(
          smoke == "Never" ~"No",
          .default = "Yes"
        ),
        hypertension = case_when(
          hypertension == "Yes" ~"Yes",
          .default = "No"
        ),
        familiyhist = case_when(
          familiyhist == "Yes" ~"Yes",
          .default = "No"
        ),
      )
    
    # rename for table
    table_survival_tmp <- table_survival_tmp %>%
      rename(
        PatientID = pat_id,
        DiseaseType = disease,
        `AC-Mortality` = status5y,
        Age = age,
        Gender = sex,
        WeightKg = weight,
        BodyMassIndex = bmi,
        Smoking = smoke,
        Diabetes = dm,
        Hypertension = hypertension,
        FamilyHistory = familiyhist,
        # lab
        Creatinine = crea,
        `hs-TroponinT` = troponinT,
        `nt-proBNP` = bnp,
        Hemoglobin = hemo,
        Bilirubin = BILI,
        Leukocytes = wbc,
        Cholesterol = cholesterol,
        EjectionFraction = echo_ef,
        LeftVentricleDilation = echo_lv_dil,
        ModelPredictionGroup = model.pred.groups,
        PredictedDiseaseProbability = .data[[colname_pred_disease]]
      ) 
    
    # Bin
    table_survival_BIN_tmp <- table_survival_BIN_tmp %>%
      rename(
        PatientID = pat_id,
        DiseaseType = disease,
        `AC-Mortality` = status5y,
        Age = age,
        Gender = sex,
        WeightKg = weight,
        BodyMassIndex = bmi,
        Smoking = smoke,
        Diabetes = dm,
        Hypertension = hypertension,
        FamilyHistory = familiyhist,
        # lab
        Creatinine = crea,
        `hs-TroponinT` = troponinT,
        `nt-proBNP` = bnp,
        Hemoglobin = hemo,
        Bilirubin = BILI,
        Leukocytes = wbc,
        Cholesterol = cholesterol,
        EjectionFraction = echo_ef,
        LeftVentricleDilation = echo_lv_dil,
        ModelPredictionGroup = model.pred.groups2,
        PredictedDiseaseProbability = .data[[colname_pred_disease]]
      ) 
    
    ## Vector of variables to summarize
    myVars <- dput(colnames(table_survival_tmp)[-(1:2)])  # remove pat id and disease (only 1 disease!)
    myVarsBIN <- dput(colnames(table_survival_BIN_tmp)[-(1:2)])  # remove pat id and disease (only 1 disease!)
    ## Vector of categorical variables that need transformation
    catVars <- c("Gender", "AC-Mortality", "Smoking", "Diabetes", "Hypertension", "FamilyHistory", "LeftVentricleDilation")
    biomarkers <- c("Creatinine", "hs-TroponinT", "nt-proBNP", "Hemoglobin", "INR", "Bilirubin", "Leukocytes", "CRP", "Cholesterol")
    
    ## Create a TableOne object
    tab1 <- CreateTableOne(vars = myVars[myVars !="ModelPredictionGroup"], strata = "ModelPredictionGroup", 
                           data = table_survival_tmp, 
                           factorVars = catVars
                           )
    print(tab1,                          
          nonnormal = biomarkers, 
          showAllLevels = FALSE, 
          formatOptions = list(big.mark = ",")
    )
    
    ## export to csv
    tab1MAT <- print(tab1, nonnormal = biomarkers, showAllLevels = FALSE, formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","), quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
    write.csv2(tab1MAT, file = glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/tables/survival/selected_APM_matched_TERTILES/005c_20240121_survTable-{model.disease.vector[mydisease]}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_matched.csv"))
    
    kableone(tab1, nonnormal = biomarkers, caption="Patient characteristics stratified by predicted disease probability tertiles") %>% 
      kable_classic() -> kable.table.surv
    print(kable.table.surv)
    
    # BINARY
    tab1_BIN <- CreateTableOne(vars = myVars[myVars !="ModelPredictionGroup"], strata = "ModelPredictionGroup", 
                           data = table_survival_BIN_tmp, 
                           factorVars = catVars
                           )
    print(tab1_BIN,                          
          nonnormal = biomarkers, 
          showAllLevels = FALSE, 
          formatOptions = list(big.mark = ",")
    )
    
    ## export to csv
    tab1MAT_BIN <- print(tab1_BIN, nonnormal = biomarkers, showAllLevels = FALSE, formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","), quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
    write.csv2(tab1MAT_BIN, file = glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/tables/survival/selected_APM_matched_BINARY/005c_20240121_survTable-{model.disease.vector[mydisease]}_{wflow_id_vector[mymodel]}_matched.csv"))
    
    kableone(tab1_BIN, nonnormal = biomarkers, caption="Patient characteristics stratified by predicted disease probability tertiles") %>% 
      kable_classic() -> kable.table.surv
    print(kable.table.surv)
  }
  
  # save logrank pvals
  logrank_pval_df_tmp %>% 
    rename(`P-val (median split)` = pval2group.logrank, 
           `P-val (tertile split)` = pval3group.logrank) %>%
    gt() %>% 
    fmt_stars(columns = starts_with("stars")) %>% 
    cols_merge(
      columns = c(`P-val (median split)`, "stars2"),
      pattern = "{1} {2}"
    ) %>%
    cols_merge(
      columns = c(`P-val (tertile split)`, "stars3"),
      pattern = "{1} {2}"
    ) %>% 
    gtsave(glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/tables/survival/logrank/005c_20240121_{toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease])}_table_logrank_pval_APM_matched.docx"))  # selected model
  
  # next DISEASE
}
```

We need to filter for CAD patients and maybe later also include Controls:

```{r k-means-clustering}
# kmeans.hcm<- kmeans(scale(df.first.hc[, 12:26]), centers=3, iter.max = 10, nstart = 1,
#        algorithm = c("Hartigan-Wong", "Lloyd", "Forgy",

  geom_vline(xintercept = 6, linetype = 2)
```

```{r k-means-clustering-for-all-6-clusterings, figures-side, fig.show='hold', out.width="33%"}
set.seed(123)
for(i in 2:6) {  # create 2 to 6 clusters
  title_plot <- paste("k = ", i)
  kmeans.ba <- kmeans(x, centers = i, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)
  
  ### name clusters
  ordered.index <- order(table(kmeans.ba$cluster), decreasing=TRUE)
  for (j in 2:max(kmeans.ba$cluster)) {
    cluster.name <- paste("Cluster ", j, sep = "")
    kmeans.ba$cluster[kmeans.ba$cluster == ordered.index[1]] <- "CAD -"
    kmeans.ba$cluster[kmeans.ba$cluster == ordered.index[j]] <- cluster.name
  }
  
  # plot clusters
  print(fviz_cluster(object = kmeans.ba, data = joined_hc_mirna1[ ,120:134],
                     geom = "point", 
                     #ellipse.type = "euclid",
                     alpha =0.5,
                     shape = 16,
                     show.legend=FALSE) +
          ggtitle(title_plot)+
          ggthemes::theme_few()+
          ggthemes::scale_color_few()+
          theme(legend.title=element_blank())
  )
}

set.seed(123)
x<- scale(joined_hc_mirna1[ ,120:134])

centers<- 6
kmeans.ba.all <- list()
for (i in 2:centers) { # create kmeans for 2:6 centers
  kmeans.ba.all[[i]] <- kmeans(x, centers=i, iter.max = 1000, nstart = 25)
}
```

```{r edit-data}
joined_hc_mirna1 %>%
```

```{r}
## Vector of variables to summarize

hc_predictions_dat_new <- hc_predictions_dat %>% 
  left_join(survival_dat1 %>% select(pat_id, status5y, smoke, dm, familiyhist, dyslipo, hypertension), by = c("pat_id"="pat_id")) %>% 
  mutate(status5y = factor(status5y, labels = c("Survived", "Died"))) %>% 
  mutate(
    dm = case_when(
      dm == "Diab (cont diet)" ~ "Yes", 
      dm == "Diab (oral med)" ~ "Yes", 
      dm == "Diab (insul dep)" ~ "Yes", 
      dm == "Diab (unsp)" ~ "Yes", 
      dm == "0" ~ "No", 
      .default = dm
    ),
    smoke = case_when(
      smoke == "Never" ~"No",
      smoke == "No" ~"No",
      smoke == "Past" ~"Yes",
      smoke == "Present" ~"Yes",
      smoke == "Yes" ~"Yes",
      .default = smoke
    ),
    hypertension = case_when(
      hypertension == "Yes" ~"Yes",
      hypertension == "Unknown" ~ NA,
      .default = hypertension
    ),
    dyslipo = case_when(
      dyslipo == "Yes" ~"Yes",
      dyslipo == "Unknown" ~ NA,
      .default = dyslipo
    ),
    familiyhist = case_when(
      familiyhist == "Yes" ~"Yes",
      familiyhist == "Unknown" ~ NA,
      .default = familiyhist
    ),
  ) %>% 
  relocate(smoke, dm, familiyhist, dyslipo, hypertension, .after = sex) %>% 
  rename(
    `AC-Mortality` = status5y,
    Age = age,
    Gender = sex,
    WeightKg = weight,
    Smoking = smoke,
    Diabetes = dm,
    Hypertension = hypertension,
    FamilyHistory = familiyhist,
  )

# rename for table

myVars <- dput(colnames(hc_predictions_dat_new)[-(1:2)])
index <- grep("^.pred_control", myVars)
myVars <- myVars[-index]
#drop vars
dropping <- c("kmeans4centers", "kmeans5centers", "kmeans4to2")
index <- myVars %in% dropping
myVars <- myVars[!index]

hc_predictions_dat_new <- hc_predictions_dat_new %>% 
  mutate(kmeans5to2 = factor(kmeans5to2, labels = c("CAD Cluster", "Severe CAD Cluster")))

## Vector of categorical variables that need transformation
catVars <- c("Gender", "AC-Mortality", "Smoking", "Diabetes", "FamilyHistory", "dyslipo", "Hypertension")   # , "kmeans5to2")
## Create a TableOne object
tab1 <- CreateTableOne(vars = myVars[myVars !="kmeans5to2"], strata = "kmeans5to2", data = hc_predictions_dat_new, factorVars = catVars)
print(tab1, showAllLevels = FALSE, formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

## export to csv
tab1MAT <- print(tab1,  nonnormal = biomarkers, showAllLevels = FALSE, formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","), quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
write.csv2(tab1MAT, file = glue("{data_path_bestageing2022}/output/tables/cad_cluster/005c_myTable-cad-hkdb_selected.csv"))

kableone(tab1,  nonnormal = biomarkers, caption="Predictions of CAD Probability Stratified by Clusters of Coronary Angiography") %>%
```

## Matched CAD characteristics

```{r matched-stats-cad-cluster}
# Convert disease to a binary factor !!! NEEDED, cave ordering!
# does not work if control is first level
#hc_predictions_dat$disease_fct <- factor(hc_predictions_dat$disease, levels=c("control", "cad"))
hc_predictions_dat_new$disease_fct <- as.factor(hc_predictions_dat_new$disease)
m.out.check <- matchit(disease_fct ~ Age + Gender, data = hc_predictions_dat_new, method = NULL, distance="glm")
# No matching - Check initial balance
summary(m.out.check)

# 1:1 NN PS matching w/o replacement
m.out1 <- matchit(disease_fct ~ Age + Gender, data = hc_predictions_dat_new,
                 method = "nearest", distance = "glm")
summary(m.out1)

matched_data <- match.data(m.out1)
hc_predictions_dat_matched_new <- matched_data %>% select(1:47)  # bring to same dimension as before
```

## Custom Clustering Plot


```{r}
# custom cluster plot ggplot

# Perform PCA on the data
pca_res <- prcomp(joined_hc_mirna1 %>% select(120:134), scale = TRUE)
# Get the first two principal components
joined_hc_mirna2 <- joined_hc_mirna1 %>% 
  mutate(PC1 = pca_res$x[,1], 
         PC2 = pca_res$x[,2])

hc_predictions_dat %>% 
  left_join(joined_hc_mirna2 %>% select(1, 120:134, PC1, PC2), by=c("pat_id" = "pat_id")) %>% 
  mutate(.pred_cad_XGB_cad = .pred_cad_XGB_cad + 0.001) %>% 
  mutate(kmeans5centers = as.factor(kmeans5centers)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y=PC2, 
             
             #shape = kmeans5centers
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = .pred_cad_XGB_cad), alpha = 0.8, size = 2,
             shape = 16
             ) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = kmeans5centers), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2, level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = thematic::okabe_ito(6)[2], high = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "CAD Probability", 
       fill = "CAD Clusters"
       #shape="Cluster"
       ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16, base_family = 'Arial')+
  scale_fill_manual(values = thematic::okabe_ito(5)) +
  # scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 18, 2, 1, 16)) +  # for example, if you have 3 clusters
  my_base_theme() -> custom_cluster_plot_5k
```
